claims.object_mention: ubiquitylation and vesicle-mediated internalization and degradation of the epidermal growth factor (EGF) receptor (EGFR)
claims.quote: CBL encodes a multivalent adaptor protein with ubiquitin ligase activity, which promotes ubiquitylation and vesicle-mediated internalization and degradation of the epidermal growth factor (EGF) receptor (EGFR).

claims.object_mention: impaired CBL-mediated EGFR ubiquitylation and degradation
claims.quote: Furthermore, the p.K382E, p.D390Y, and p.R420Q lesions impaired CBL-mediated EGFR ubiquitylation and degradation.

Since we detected enhanced ERK phosphorylation in cells expressing mutant CBL, we conclude that aberrant EGFR trafficking contributes to augmented RAS-MAPK signaling, the common trait of Noonan syndrome and related RASopathies.
Thus, our data suggest that EGFR trafficking is a novel disease-relevant regulatory level in the RASopathy network.
